title: Foglia's Can't Sleep Till The End
description: Prevents the player from sleeping and skipping the night until they have defeated the Ender Dragon.
body:
**Prevents you from sleeping until you defeat the Ender Dragon.**

This mod makes it so that the player can't skip the night by sleeping until they have defeated the Ender Dragon.
Once the Ender Dragon is defeated, the sleeping behaviour reverts back to the default Vanilla Minecraft one.
